data.name: ASSISTANCE_REQUEST_CHANGE_EVENT_EVENT_NAME
data.comment: Event name: a change occurred on an assistance request. Noun (the change), not a verb. Translate as "change/modification", not as "to change".

data.value: Authentication failed due to a network error

data.value: Failed due to an invalid instance id

data.value: Failed due to an expired token

data.name: AUTHORIZATION_WARNINGS_FUTURE_PAYMENT_DESCRIPTION
data.value: Future payments may fail due to card expiration

data.name: AUTHORIZATION_WARNINGS_NONE_NAME
data.comment: Enum value meaning "no warnings". Refers to the noun "warning". In gendered languages, choose the form agreeing with "warning".

data.name: INSTANCE_ID_TYPE_HARDWARE_ID_NAME
data.comment: License instance identifier sourced from machine hardware (CPU/disk/etc fingerprint). Treat "Hardware id" as a domain term; keep "id" lowercase as a stylistic choice. In target languages, may be transliterated or kept as-is.

data.name: INVOICE_PAYMENT_EVENT_DESCRIPTION
data.value: Indicates creation of an invoice payment

data.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE_NONE
data.comment: Enum value: notification type = none (silent / no notification). Refers to "notification type" noun. Translate to agree with "type" in target language.

data.name: OPTIONS_CHANGE_EVENT_NAME
data.comment: Event name: options changed. Noun (the change). Translate as "change/modification".

data.name: ORDER_DELIVERY_STATUS_CHANGE_EVENT_NAME
data.comment: Event name: order-delivery status changed. Noun (the change). Translate as "change/modification".

data.name: ORDER_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS_CHANGE_EVENT_DESCRIPTION
data.value: Indicates order line delivery status change

data.name: ORDER_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS_CHANGE_EVENT_NAME
data.comment: Event name: order-line delivery status changed. Noun (the change). Translate as "change/modification".

data.name: ORDER_STATUS_CHANGE_EVENT_NAME
data.comment: Event name: order status changed (e.g. OnHold → Accepted, Accepted → Completed). Noun (the change). Translate as "change/modification".

data.name: PRODUCT_STOCK_CHANGE_EVENT_GROUP_NAME
data.comment: Event group name: product-stock changes. Noun (the change). Translate as "change/modification".

data.name: RESTRICTION_TYPE_CLASS_NAME
data.comment: Application-restriction type: target an application by its window-class name (Win32 WNDCLASS). Programming concept, not a school/group "class". Generally keep as "Class Name" or transliterate.

data.name: PAYMENT_TRANSACTION_DIRECTION_IN
data.comment: Payment transaction direction: payment received (money in). Distinct from inventory direction or other "in/out" senses.

data.name: PAYMENT_TRANSACTION_DIRECTION_OUT
data.comment: Payment transaction direction: payment paid out (money out, e.g. refund or register transaction).

data.name: PAYMENT_INTENT_STATE_CAPTURED
data.comment: Payment-domain term: funds have been captured (charged to the customer's payment method, finalising an authorised intent). NOT "captured" as in "screenshot/recording". Keep payment-industry vocabulary.

data.name: PAYMENT_INTENT_CAPTURED_EVENT_NAME
data.comment: Payment-domain event: funds were captured (charged to customer). NOT "captured" as in "screenshot". Keep payment-industry vocabulary.

data.name: BILLING_OPTION_NONE_NAME
data.comment: Enum value meaning "no billing option selected" (i.e. all billing features enabled — this is the default with no opt-outs). Refers to "billing option" noun. Translate to agree with "option" in target language.

data.name: PRODUCT_GROUP_DELETE_RESULT_NON_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION

data.name: APPLICATION_CATEGORY_DELETE_RESULT_NON_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION

data.name: APPLICATION_CATEGORY_DELETE_RESULT_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION

data.name: STOCK_TRANSACTION_TYPE_RETURN_NAME
data.comment: Stock-movement type: returning stock (e.g. to vendor or back to inventory). NOT "return" as in "go back" or the keyboard Return key. Translate as the inventory verb.

data.name: USAGE_TYPE_NONE_NAME
data.comment: None represents an unknown usage type, usually only possible with external plugin modules.
